grammar.summary: 本课学习过去完成时的初步用法（had + 过去分词）。

points.title: 过去完成时 had + 过去分词
points.explanation: 过去某时之前已完成的动作：She had never been on a train before.（在那之前从未坐过火车）。过去完成时必须依托一个"过去参照点"。

examples.en: Sally had never travelled on a train before.
examples.cn: Sally 以前从未坐过火车旅行。

examples.en: The train had just left when we arrived.
examples.cn: 我们到的时候火车刚开走。

exercises.q: Does anyone ever air this room? Someone airs it regularly. This room ___ by someone regularly.
Does anyone ever clean these rooms? Someone cleans these rooms regularly. These rooms ___ by someone regularly.
Does anyone ever empty this basket? Someone empties it regularly. It ___ by someone regularly.
Does anyone ever sharpen this pencil? Someone sharpens it regularly. It ___ by someone regularly.
Did anyone water these flowers? Someone watered these flowers regularly. They ___ by someone regularly.
Did anyone repair this car? Someone repaired this car regularly. It ___ by someone regularly.
Did anyone dust this cupboard? Someone dusted it regularly. It ___ by someone regularly.
Did anyone correct these exercise books? Someone corrected them regularly. They ___ by someone regularly.
